name: Kit + CampPowerUp Community Server

channels.name: welcome
channels.topic: Start here! Introduction to the server, what Kit and CampPowerUp are, and how to get involved.

channels.name: rules
channels.topic: Server rules and code of conduct. Read before participating.

channels.name: announcements
channels.topic: Server-wide announcements from the staff team.

channels.name: roles-info
channels.topic: What each role means and how to get one.

channels.name: general
channels.topic: General chat — say hi, hang out, talk about anything (within the rules).

channels.name: off-topic
channels.topic: Memes, games, and everything not related to the projects.

channels.name: bot-commands
channels.topic: Talk to Kit here! Use ! commands or mention @Kit. Keeps bot spam out of other channels.

channels.name: bot-help
channels.topic: Questions about using Kit, feature requests, and bug reports.

channels.name: bot-logs
channels.topic: Kit status and diagnostic logs. Staff and developers only.

channels.name: camp-announcements
channels.topic: CampPowerUp project news, releases, and milestones.

channels.name: camp-dev
channels.topic: Development discussion: architecture, PRs, issues, and technical planning.

channels.name: camp-support
channels.topic: Get help with CampPowerUp — ask questions, report problems.

channels.name: camp-feedback
channels.topic: Ideas, suggestions, and feedback for CampPowerUp.

channels.name: staff-chat
channels.topic: Private discussion for Admins and Moderators.
